findings.text: follow-on: The 550-cell parameter tests offsets where containment-only proposals also retain 3 roots and 2 saddles, so this parameter does not fail if neighbour proposals regress at that carrier.

follow-on: The direct-current comparator receives membership, path weight and flux limits from the same reading that drives booked current, so a wrong support or limit can move both sides together and leave this assertion green.

item_verdicts.diff: Twelve commits from 8fb29acd through f7ed7e9d change seven files; census.py:44-139 widens and ranks proposals, proposal_probe.py:22 delegates candidate counting, and test_topology_read.py:2844-2878 adds the paired read check.
item_verdicts.done_when: brief.txt requires paired window counts, fold or persistence evidence, a containment control and three-file base/head gates; window-282.json, window-550.json, fold-rounding-compiled.log, negative-control.log and head-gate-verified.log record them.
item_verdicts.goal: brief.txt asks for stationary proposal coverage; scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:121 recovers the 282-cell pre-fold saddle, while docs/research/census-proposal-coverage.html:68 leaves the TCV and JT-60SA adapters unmeasured.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md is complete and names twelve commits, the base/head batch logs, the red containment control, and the unmeasured adapter follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: manifest.md declares seven allowed paths, and git diff de1186f0..f7ed7e9d changes exactly seven files within those paths.

justifications.durability: tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py:2868 turns red at the 282-cell high offset when containment-only proposals are restored, as negative-control.log records, but the 550-cell parameter remains green under that mutation.
justifications.evidence: proposal_probe.py:22 reads the census's actual candidate count, and base-gate-cache.log plus head-gate-verified.log complete with identical twelve-id failure sets and zero added failures.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:44 uses the carrier's existing neighbour table with fixed-shape JAX operations, and its added source names contain no plan or release labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:121 admits edge-neighbour seeds and preserves the measured 282-cell saddle, while docs/research/census-proposal-coverage.html:68 limits the claim to the tested carriers.
justifications.reuse: proposal_probe.py:22 wraps the candidate owner in census.py:121, and proposal_compare.py:48 reuses tie_probe.row rather than implementing either capability again.
justifications.scope_discipline: The seven paths in git diff de1186f0..f7ed7e9d all fall within the seven write_paths in manifest.md and serve the census, its measurements, or its research record.
